method: Bounded corrections of two omitted Scripture clauses and one mistranscribed word in the pinned eBible transcription. Both independently published Challoner/Douay–Rheims witnesses give each identical complete verse. The original archive stays unchanged; only the named source coordinates are corrected during canonical import. No other wording, source label or edition is substituted.

corrections.originalText: Thy wife as a fruitful vine, on the sides of thy house.
corrections.correctedText: Thy wife as a fruitful vine, on the sides of thy house. Thy children as olive plants, round about thy table.

corrections.originalText: When my spirit failed me, then thou newest my paths.
